technique_name: Write an article about the advantages of using a GPT model for natural language understanding.
description: GPT models are an incredibly powerful tool for natural language understanding. They allow for the rapid development of sophisticated models for understanding complex, natural language. GPT models are able to understand a variety of different linguistic structures and can perform tasks such as sentiment analysis, question answering and language translation.
